messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-04-01, the indexer is owned by the Boreal team. [constraint; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team. [constraint; valid 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; recorded by handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Cinder team. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- On 2026-02-10, the Boreal team noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the indexer's owners. [valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2]
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- On 2026-06-04, the Boreal team noticed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]
- On 2026-03-20, the Boreal team observed that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2]
- As of 2025-06-11, team Dune owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then. [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-11, the Cinder team owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then. [valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [constraint; valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-22]
- Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
- Marcus took over the Boreal team on-call shift from Lena on 2025-05-07. [decision; valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07]
- As of 2025-05-15, the webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-05-15-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-03-03 to 2025-05-15; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-03; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3]
- The Boreal team consists of Lena, after Marcus moved to the Atlas team on 2026-03-20. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
    earlier: The Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus. [valid 2025-01-07 to 2026-03-20; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-07]
- On 2026-05-27, the Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- The Boreal team observed that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03-2]
- On 2026-06-09, team Dune observed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-06-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-09]
- INC-2025-023 was an indexer incident on 2025-10-03 in which the indexer served stale results for two days. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Lena takes over the pager rotation for the Boreal team from Marcus in the cycle starting 2025-03-17. [decision; valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-17]
    earlier: Marcus takes over the pager rotation for the Boreal team from Lena on 2025-02-12. [decision; valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-12]
    earlier: Lena takes the first pager rotation for the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-02-12; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-4]
- As of 2026-02-10, Marcus Oyelaran has the Boreal team pager this cycle, taking over from Lena. [decision; valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-10]
- As of 2026-02-10, Marcus Oyelaran has the Boreal team pager this cycle, taking over from Lena. [decision; valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-10]
    earlier: As of 2025-12-18, Lena has the Boreal team pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus. [decision; valid 2025-12-18 to 2026-02-10; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-18]
